sources.source: Viking MDIM 2.1 colorized global mosaic (232 m/px) via JPL Mars Trek WMTS
processing: Read WMTSCapabilities.xml; matrix default028mm level 4 = 32x16 tiles of 256 px, top-left (-180, 90)
Fetched all 512 JPEG tiles (row/col order as in the template)
Stitched without resampling into 8192x4096
JPEG q82 (mozjpeg)

sources.licence: NASA data: generally not copyrighted, cite source. USGS data: public domain, cite publication.
processing: Lanczos3 downsample of the 8192x4096 stitch to 2048x1024
JPEG q85 (mozjpeg)

sources.licence: NASA data: generally not copyrighted, cite source. USGS data: public domain, cite publication.
sources.source: MGS MOLA MEGDR median topography, 16 pixel/degree (megt90n000eb), PDS Geosciences Node; ODY not involved
processing: Big-endian int16 5760x2880, lon 0..360 E, top row = 90N, heights in m above the MOLA areoid
Rotated columns by 180 deg so col 0 = lon -180
2x2 box mean to 2880x1440 (1/8 deg ~ 7.4 km at the equator), rounded to integer metres
Int16 little-endian, scale 1, offset 0, nodata -32768 (none present), gzip -9

sources.licence: NASA data: generally not copyrighted, cite source. USGS data: public domain, cite publication.
processing: Area-weighted box resample 2880x1440 -> 2048x1024
Hypsometric colour ramp -8200..21300 m

sources.licence: NASA data: generally not copyrighted, cite source. USGS data: public domain, cite publication.
processing: Central-difference gradient on the sphere (dx = R cos(lat) dlon, dy = R dlat), slope = atan(|grad|)
Box resample to 2048x1024
viridis colour ramp 0..20 deg, 256-colour palette PNG

sources.licence: NASA data: generally not copyrighted, cite source. USGS data: public domain, cite publication.
processing: Slope in degrees, 2048x1024, uint8 value = deg/0.25 (max 63.5 deg), nodata 255 (none), gzip -9

sources.source: USGS SIM 3292 shapefile SIM3292_Global_Geology (served by Mars Trek item SIM3292_Global_Geology; publication https://pubs.usgs.gov/sim/3292/)
processing: Read shapefile (GCS_Mars_2000, lon -180..180 E already) with the Unit and UnitDesc attributes
1311 polygons, 44 units
Douglas-Peucker 0.03 deg per ring, tiny holes dropped, coords rounded to 0.001 deg, bbox per polygon
Colours assigned by hue per epoch (no colours in the dbf)

sources.licence: NASA data: generally not copyrighted, cite source. USGS data: public domain, cite publication.
processing: Even-odd scanline fill of the full-resolution polygons at 2048x1024, pixel-centre sampling
Palette PNG; unmapped pixels transparent

processing: uint8 unit index, 0 = none, gzip -9

sources.source: ODY GRS element concentration map h2o_sr_5x5
processing: Parsed 2592 ASCII rows (lat, lon E 0..360, wt% H2O, sigma); 9999.999 = no data
Re-indexed to lon -180..180 and 5 degree bins
Bilinear between valid bin centres onto a 720x360 grid; no-data bins stay transparent
YlGnBu ramp 0..12 wt%, palette PNG

sources.licence: NASA data: generally not copyrighted, cite source. USGS data: public domain, cite publication.
processing: uint8 value = wt%/0.1 (max 25.4), nodata 255, 720x360, gzip -9

sources.source: MGS TES night thermal inertia map, PDS
processing: Big-endian int16 7200x3600, -180..180 E, 20 ppd; values outside 5..5000 treated as nodata
Area-weighted box resample (valid pixels only) to 2048x1024
inferno ramp, log10 25..1200 tiu; nodata transparent

processing: Resampled values rounded to integer tiu, int16 LE, nodata -32768, gzip -9

sources.source: Mars Trek TES_Dust (MGS TES Global Dust Cover Index, colourised GeoTIFF 2880x1440)
processing: Read 8-bit RGB GeoTIFF (bbox -180,-90,180,90)
Pure black = no data -> alpha 0
Cubic resample to 1024x512 (keeps total size under 25 MB), 128-colour palette PNG
Values NOT recovered (colour scale unpublished)

sources.source: Mars Trek landing-site bookmarks (searchItems) + NASA mission pages; USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (MARS_nomenclature_center_pts)
processing: Landing coordinates: bbox centre of the Trek bookmark (Pathfinder: Trek product sojourner_hirise_mosaic bbox; Perseverance: given coordinates)
Mission pages checked HTTP 200 during this run
45 IAU features picked by name from the gazetteer, lon converted 0..360 E -> -180..180 E, each linked to its planetarynames page (HTTP status checked)
